rows.after: A well-prepared claim tests each project against the three statutory criteria before anything is written up, draws the project boundary around the experimental work and its commensurate support work, and documents the uncertainty, the investigation and the advancement from the records the team already generates. It separates eligible development from client-paid delivery, allocates salaries by project from time records, and models the proxy method against the traditional method rather than defaulting to one.

rows.before: We separate the salary base from total payroll so bonuses and benefits do not inflate the proxy amount, apply the specified employee caps in Regulations 2900(7) and 2900(8), establish the Canadian portion of contractor work before applying the 80% inclusion, and test cloud and subscription costs for whether they are genuinely incremental before claiming them.
